title: Functions & Reusable Code
description: Stop copy-pasting. Write once, use everywhere. Functions are the foundation of all real code.

title: Debugging & Problem Solving
description: Code breaks. Learn to read errors, use Claude to debug, and think through problems systematically.

title: Thinking Like a Programmer
description: Break big problems into small steps. Algorithms aren't scary — they're just recipes for computers.

title: Variables and Types
description: Store a value under a name, change it later, and know at a glance whether you're holding a number, text or a true/false — including the exact moment JavaScript quietly turns one into another and what to do about it.

title: Making Decisions
description: Write code that behaves differently depending on the situation — if/else branching, the comparison operators that make a condition true or false, combining conditions with and/or/not, and the discipline of accounting for every case, not just the one you thought of first.

title: Doing Things Repeatedly
description: Repeat work without copy-pasting it — counting a known number of times with a for loop, repeating until a condition changes with a while loop, stopping or skipping early with break and continue, and building up a running result as you go, plus how to spot and stop a loop that never ends.

title: Functions
description: Package work into named, reusable pieces with clear inputs and outputs — what a function actually is versus calling it, how arguments and parameters connect, what a return value hands back (and what a function returns when it doesn't have one), how to spot code that's crying out to become a function, and the discipline of keeping each function doing exactly one job.

title: Lists and Records
description: Hold a collection of things with an array, describe one thing with named fields using an object, then combine the two into an array of objects — the shape almost all real data actually takes — and learn to choose deliberately between a list, a record, or a list of records for a given situation.
